messages:
Ajay: pushed a tiny docs change and merged ~5m ago, main CI turned red — gpu-smoke step OOMing repeatedly. @Kate can you take a quick look? :eyes:

CI-Bot: main pipeline failed: https://ci.redwood/run/4321 — failed step: gpu-smoke-matrix (nvcrun) logs attached.

Maria: hmm did the smoke matrix change recently? any new model or batchsize?

Ajay: PR #4320 (docs+env tweak) — no code changes but CI image shows kernel bumped 5.11.2 -> 5.13.0 in the recent infra-rollout. suspect commit f3a2b7c in infra-image.

CI-Bot: failing log excerpt:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory while allocating 2.0 GiB (out of memory)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/smoke_gpu.py", line 42, in run
    out = model.generate(inp)
```

Oliver: could be infra/kernel drift or libcuda update. @Kate if you can rerun with SMALL_BATCH=1 and --no-prefetch to see if it's batchsize-sensitive?

Kate: I can take this. starting by rerunning the failing job with SMALL_BATCH=1 (queued). cc @sre-oncall

Ajay: thanks. If it's infra, we should fail open on merge or revert infra roll. I'm around if you need a quick revert.

Kate: rerun finished — still fails, same OOM. I grabbed gcore from runner: /var/crash/gcore.1234 shows memory used ~11.7Gi, RSS spike at step 6.

sre-oncall: we rolled kernel 5.13.0 yesterday to all runners. I'm going to pin a pool to 5.11.2 and trigger a rerun on that pool now.

Maria: can we bisect to isolate commit? Ajay which commit range should we try?

Ajay: suspect infra change landed in infra/runner-image@a1b2c3..d4e5f6; if rerun passes on 5.11.2 that's a smoking gun. happy to open revert if needed.

Oliver: I'll start a quick git bisect on infra-image repo, will report back in this thread.

CI-Bot: rerun queued on pinned pool (kernel 5.11.2).

Kate: rerun on 5.11.2 pool passed. :thumbsup: Looks like kernel/driver regression.

Ajay: OK let's revert the infra rollout and create a hotfix for runner-image. I'll open PR to pin kernel for smoke runners until a proper patch lands.

Maria: sounds good. tagging infra-team for follow up. Thanks all for the quick triage.

Oliver: bisect found the driver bump in commit d4e5f6 that upgraded the cuda driver package — that's the culprit. raising PR to roll back the driver change.

Ajay: great. I'll monitor main and keep status here. closing triage for now — reopen if it flares. :white_check_mark:
